CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
August 6, 2025, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for July 2, 2025, Planning Commission meeting.

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Erika Diaz for
  Special Use Permit No. 25-00015 (SUP25-00015) to allow the sale
  of beer and wine for off-site consumption for an existing service
  station convenience market on an MU-C (Mixed Use Corridor) zoned
  property at 633 West Manchester Blvd.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-087) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to
  bespinoza@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-087;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00015.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  This Item has been continued to October 1, 2025.

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by Sohail Bashirian,
  representing the owner, for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00016(SUP25-00016) to allow the on-site sale of distilled
  spirits for an existing restaurant on a C-2 zoned property at
  1122 Centinela Avenue.

  A Notice of Exemption (EA-CE-2025-085) has been prepared stating
  that the proposed project is categorically exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act, a copy of which is
  available for public review in the Planning Division office of
  City  Hall  and  via  email  request  to
  faith.smith@cityofinglewood.org.
   Preliminary Recommendations
  A.If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the request,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-085;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP25-00016.
  B.If the Planning Commision determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it is
  recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C.If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6b Documents

c. A public hearing to consider an application by Megan Divine
  representing HAS INWD Property Owner, LLC, for General Plan
  Amendment No. 24-00002 (GPA24-00002) to allow a request to
  amend the Land Use Element Map of the Inglewood General Plan
  from Low Density to Medium Density for an approximately 68-
  acre site (Morningside High School and Monroe Middle School)
  with approximately 22.87 acres designated for a proposed
  multiple-family residential development at (AINs: 4030-033-
  901, 4030-033-903, and 4030-033-904).

  A Sustainable Communities Environmental Assessment(EA-SCEA-
  2025-035) has been prepared stating that with the recommended
  mitigation measures the proposed project will have no
  significant adverse impact upon the environment, a copy of
  which is available for public review in the Planning Division
  office  and  via  email  request  to  al-
  martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to RECOMMEND APPROVAL,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Adopt the resolution recommending approval to the City
  Council of GPA24-00002; and
  2) Recommend that City Council affirm the Sustainable
  Community Environmental Assessment  (SCEA) EA-SCEA-2025-
  035
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents

d. A public hearing to consider an application by Megan Divine
  representing HAS INWD Property Owner, LLC, for Zone Change No.
  24-00001 (ZC24-00001) to allow a request to change the zoning
  from R-1 (One-family Residential) to R-3 (Multiple-family
  Residential) for an approximately 68-acre site (Morningside High
  School and Monroe Middle School) with approximately 22.87 acres
  designated  for  a  proposed  multiple-family  residential
  development at (AINs: 4030-033-901, 4030-033-903, and 4030-033-
  904).

  A Sustainable Communities Environmental Assessment(EA-SCEA-
  2025-035) has been prepared stating that with the recommended
  mitigation measures the proposed project will have no
  significant adverse impact upon the environment, a copy of which
  is available for public review in the Planning Division office
  and via email request to al-martell@cityofinglewood.org.

  2
   Preliminary Recommendations
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to RECOMMEND APPROVAL,
  it is recommended to:
  1) Adopt the resolution recommending approval to the City
  Council of ZC24-00001.
  B. If the Planning Commission determines to ADD CONDITIONS, it
  is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of conditions
  as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the request or
  any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning Commission
  on any matter within their jurisdiction and not elsewhere
  considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of August 6, 2025, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
